scope: Generic LED strip, cubby shelf and tower air-purifier primitives; colorable bedding; immediate saved-coordinate lookup for repeated marker keys. Two private room models.

validation.new_primitives: Finite GPU geometry, local strip lighting without treating fan as light, 2D selection, consecutive-key regression passed.
validation.existing: Lighting pure and browser, object picking/animations/editor/default views, 14 fictitious card groups, room explorer 1000 updates, resource lifecycle 100 mounts/1000 updates, climate/notices/collection passed.
validation.private: Two room models inspected in 2D/3D, day and night, simulated PC/TV, editor and return; 320/390/736/1150 px, no overflow or page/GL error. Pilot model delta restricted to three objects and one associated label/anchor; all other positions/bindings preserved.
validation.initial_test_failure: A repeated-key interaction exposed use of a stale rendered marker. Resolved by looking up current saved hotspot; regression dispatches two events before the next frame.

publication.ci: Local checks only; skip-ci draft branch/PR.

limitations: A network-presence PC signal does not prove power.
Unavailable TV is not shown as controllable or online.
Light spill is an approximation within the existing eight-source budget.
